topic: The "write it in my voice" prompt: show Claude an example of your writing
post:
Does AI-written email sound… nothing like you? 🤖
Here's the fix: show Claude how YOU write.

Anthropic's own prompting guide says examples are one of the most reliable ways to steer Claude's tone, format and structure.

So instead of describing your style, just show it. 👇

Copy-paste prompt:

"Here are 2 emails I've written before. Notice my tone, length and how I open and close:
[paste email 1]
[paste email 2]

Now write a reply to the message below in the same style. Keep it under 120 words. If you're missing a detail, ask me instead of making it up.
[paste the message you're replying to]"

Tips that help ✍️
📌 Pick examples you're proud of
📌 Remove anything private before pasting
📌 Read it before you send it. You're still the author.

Why it matters:
Generic prompts get generic writing. One real example of your style teaches Claude more than a paragraph of instructions. ✨

Works for emails, Slack replies, LinkedIn posts, even meeting follow-ups.

What would you want Claude to write in your voice first? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.

#Claude #AI #AIForBeginners #Productivity
